description: You are a Search Marketing Strategist conducting a monthly technical SEO health check for an e-commerce client (books.toscrape.com). The client wants a full on-page SEO audit covering their four most critical ranking signals. Use Screaming Frog SEO Spider to crawl https://books.toscrape.com/ (crawl at least 100 pages). After the crawl: (1) Export the page titles report to ~/Documents/SEO/exports/ — must show Title 1, title length, and flag any duplicate or missing titles. (2) Export the meta descriptions report to ~/Documents/SEO/exports/ — must show Meta Description 1 and flag any missing or duplicate meta descriptions. (3) Export the H1 tags report to ~/Documents/SEO/exports/ — must show H1-1 and flag missing H1s. (4) Write a comprehensive audit summary at ~/Documents/SEO/reports/on_page_audit.txt that provides specific issue counts for each category (page titles, meta descriptions, H1 tags) and prioritized recommendations for the client. Login: user=ga, desktop GUI application.
